body: character reference sheet T-POSE, straight-on front view (NOT a three-quarter angle, camera facing directly at the character), arms outstretched horizontally like an airplane / scarecrow -- a chibi voxel-block toy figure of an armored knight-engineer, BOTH ARMS RAISED STRAIGHT OUT TO THE SIDES at exactly shoulder height, elbows fully straight, a large visible gap between each arm and the torso, both blocky hands fully visible in frame (not cropped at the image edge) with fingers spread, nothing held. Big oversized blocky head and a broad stocky short blocky body (chibi toy-figure proportions), made of assembled rectangular blocks, every part a flat rectangular block with hard 90-degree edges, bold thick black outline stroke around every edge like a toy render. Legs straight, shoulder-width apart. The FULL BODY (helmet, torso armor, arms, legs, boots) is matte DARK NAVY-CHARCOAL BLOCK ARMOR -- same very dark blue-grey-black color as a knight's plate armor, NOT tan, NOT beige, NOT a skin-colored face visible, NOT a construction-worker jumpsuit -- with thick GOLD trim block accents along every panel edge. A fully-enclosed blocky armored helmet (no visible human face/skin) shaped like a hardhat-visor hybrid, with two flat glowing TURQUOISE-CYAN rectangular lenses for eyes. A wrench block holstered flat on the belt. Flat toy-voxel render style, single flat even lighting, plain flat grey background, full body visible head to feet, generous empty margin on both sides so nothing is cropped, no text, no logos, no watermark
